About the Job

Account Director, Specialty Pharmacy Networks (GPO, IDN & Limited Distribution)

The Account Director, Specialty Pharmacy Networks is responsible for leading contractual, and operational engagement across applicable Limited Distribution Networks (LDN), Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs), Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), and select independent pharmacy partners across Specialty Care and General Medicines portfolios reporting to the Senior Director, Specialty Pharmacy Strategic & Limited Networks.

This role serves as the lead for institutional customer engagement, and contracting execution, ensuring optimal product and patient access, financial performance, service delivery, data exchange, and overall patient experience across the distribution ecosystem. The role also leads GPO channel execution and serves as the Trade & Channel subject matter expert and customer-facing lead for Health Systems and IDNs.

We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our teams work together to advance treatment, improve products, understand unmet needs, and connect communities. We pursue Progress to make a meaningful impact on patients around the world.

Reports to Senior Director, Limited Network & Rare Blood Pharmacy Trade Accounts

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi
We are an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Account lead for Sanofi’s independent pharmacy partners, GPOs, and institutional customers

  • Execute and inform GPO and IDN Trade & Channel strategy, including customer-facing engagement, contract evaluation, GTN management, and negotiations across Specialty Care and General Medicines

  • Serve as the primary customer-facing lead for Health Systems and IDNs, addressing access, pricing, contracting, and channel strategy execution

  • Own respective accounts’ GTN performance across all OID, data, and service contracts, ensuring disciplined financial management and optimization

  • Drive network performance to improve patient access, conversion, and adherence across targeted partners

  • Establish and lead partner accountability through QBRs, performance management, and data-driven insights

  • Develop and execute strategic network and customer plans tied to measurable access, financial, and operational outcomes

  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with key decision-makers across pharmacy operations, trade relations, and clinical stakeholders

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for assigned networks and customers, overseeing performance tracking, issue resolution, and continuous improvement

  • Ensure network partners meet required infrastructure, service, and compliance standards for limited distribution products

  • Identify and evaluate independent pharmacy opportunities to expand access in targeted or underserved geographies

  • Monitor and manage partner performance across KPIs, including patient onboarding, adherence, dispense performance, inventory, and service quality

  • Lead quarterly business reviews with external partners and internal stakeholders to assess performance and optimize collaboration

  • Partner with analytics and operations teams to translate network and patient data into actionable insights

  • Align patient, product, and pharmacy strategies across Trade, Brand, Market Access, Field Sales, Patient Services, Legal, and Compliance to ensure coordinated execution

  • Provide customer and network insights to inform go-to-market strategies, launch planning, and ongoing portfolio optimization

  • Support field teams with tools, insights, and network-specific strategies to enhance provider and patient access

About You

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • 7+ years of experience in pharmaceutical market access, trade, specialty pharmacy, or network management

  • Experience managing limited distribution networks and specialty pharmacy relationships

  • Strong knowledge of GPO, IDN, and health system dynamics, including contracting and reimbursement models

  • Proven experience in contract negotiation, GTN management, and financial accountability

  • Deep understanding of specialty product access, patient journey, and distribution logistics

  • Strong communication, influencing, and relationship management skills

  • Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed environment

  • Ability to travel up to 30–40%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading GPO or institutional contracting strategies

  • Payer contracts experience

  • Market Access contracting experience

  • Experience working with independent specialty pharmacies within limited networks

  • Experience supporting product launches and complex distribution models

  • Advanced degree (MBA or similar)

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it is through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

Navitus - Putting People First in Pharmacy - Navitus was founded as an alternative to traditional pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) models. We are committed to removing cost from the drug supply chain to make medications more affordable for the people who need them. At Navitus, our team members work in an environment that celebrates diversity, fosters creativity and encourages growth. Overview

Due to growth, we are adding an Enterprise Solutions Architect to our IT Enterprise Architecture department.

The Enterprise Solutions Architect is responsible for participating in the design, construction, maintenance, and enhancement of the Navitus IT infrastructure and application landscape. With minimal leadership and tactical supervision, the incumbents collaborate with clients, staff, IT colleagues, and other stakeholders to identify user requirements, assess available technologies, and recommend solution options to meet the operational needs of Navitus. In addition to administering multiple systems, this role will architect and implement long-term and short-term solutions to achieve the business needs. Incumbents also play an important leadership role as a senior member of the Infrastructure and Enterprise Architecture teams. Incumbents apply knowledge of various technical strategies to accurately anticipate organizational impacts. They share responsibility with other team members to ensure on-time product delivery, which requires a clear understanding of expectations and capabilities and the ability to act effectively as a team member. This role will function as a technical lead for corporate strategic initiatives.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Research utilization and capacity planning of existing technologies to plan for future growth

  • Recognized as a system expert in multiple core enterprise systems and be able to effectively provide knowledge training to peers
  • Provide after-hours support
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • A four-year college or university degree required in the field of Information Technology and/or a minimum of 7+ years of professional experience in hardware or software installation and support
  • Participate in and support capacity planning and the development of long-term strategic goals for systems and software in conjunction with end-users, third party vendors, and department managers
  • Participate the planning of upgrades/releases of Linux and Windows operating systems and associated software to limit user impact
  • Research and recommend innovative, automated approaches for system administration tasks and integration with other enterprise level business applications
  • Research emerging technologies, products, products, languages, and standards in support of procurement and development efforts
  • Participate in the design, planning, implementation and coordination for all activities needed for the successful integration of new solutions
  • Proven ability to interview end-users for insight on functionality, interface, problems, and/or usability issues
  • Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle
  • Healthcare industry practices and HIPAA knowledge would be a plus
  • Knowledge of applicable data privacy practices and laws
  • On-call availability
  • Some travel may be required

Job Title: Master Class - Business Consultant - Life Sciences Analytics (United Kingdom)

Job Location: London, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the Life Sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.
We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.
Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.
Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.
Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.
If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.
The anticipated start date is April 2027.

What You'll Do

    • Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, data analysis, managing timelines)
    • Leverage data and analytics to deliver insights and business solutions, powered by Veeva’s Data Cloud
    • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, process, and analytics
REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
    • 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
    • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    • An analytical type of person who loves digging into numbers and other data to find insights
    • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
    • Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or a comparable coding language
    • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
    • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
    • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team
THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
    • You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
    • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
    • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise
    • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
    • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view
Work Authorization: Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United Kingdom. Veeva is unable to provide sponsorship for employment visas for this position.
Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week. There is no requirement to live near a Veeva office if a candidate is in proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements.

Job Title: Therapeutic Strategy Director - Internal Medicine

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Level: Therapeutic Strategy Director – Internal Medicine

Location: Home-based in USA

JOB OVERVIEW

Internal Medicine is a core, complex focus at IQVIA, requiring deep expertise and integrated data-driven strategies. The Therapeutic Strategy Leader (TSL) translates scientific and market complexity into actionable plans, collaborating with clients and teams to ensure internal medicine programs are optimized and deliver value in a competitive landscape.

The ideal candidate is an experienced, consultative leader responsible for driving early engagement and proposals aligned with client needs in collaboration with the business development and other stakeholders. TSL will serve as a therapeutic and operational strategy expert throughout the new business and program/project delivery lifecycle to increase IQVIAs therapeutic market share with early engagement and innovative strategic responses to proposals.

This pivotal role represents and demonstrates IQVIA’s credibility with clients, furthering the R&DS business by designing market-leading solutions to secure new projects. Drawing on dedicated proposal development, technical and scientific support, the TSL will be expected to lead cross-functional teams in designing such solutions and ensuring projects are set up to be successful from proposal development through to award. The TSL will take ownership of high-level client relationships for the specified engagements in close collaboration with the sales and account team, with ultimate responsibility for securing business, client satisfaction, project margin, and differentiating IQVIA.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Growth and Client Engagement:

  • Leverage IQVIA medical, scientific, operational and data science experts to determine the optimal solution, project design and lead a cross-functional team in proposal development through to award.
  • Assigned to take ownership of developing client-centric solutions, designing both strategic and methodological approaches to ensure that IQVIA secures client projects.
  • Champion and advocate the CORE-powered solutions and include existing and new innovative solutions as applicable and appropriate through the sales process. This may include, but is not limited to, stand-alone programs and projects, requests for information (RFI), capabilities, and early engagement.

Strategy Development:

  • As a leader of the pre-award strategy team, TSL is accountable and responsible for creation of innovative, effective, and compelling therapeutic and operational strategies that client differentiates IQVIA from its competitors.
  • Work with key internal stakeholders and pre/post-award teams to analyze information and data that enables development of efficient and feasible delivery solutions. This may include, but is not limited to, protocol feasibility and risk management, assessment and management of the competitive landscape, optimal country and site distributions, site and patient recruitment strategies, monitoring and vendor strategies.
  • Actively support Sales in the preparation and conduct of client and bid defense meetings e.g. training and preparation of the assigned project team; provide specific content; ensure presentation focus and content effectively conveys project strategy and critical win themes. Attend and present at client meetings, or bid defense meetings, as required, (based on the strategy for selling the opportunity).

Strategy Translation and Post Award Support

  • Translate the sold strategy to the delivery team and be an available resource for the delivery team when changes to strategy are required.
  • Provide post award strategy guidance and support to delivery teams if in-flight studies require changes to strategy

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Remain up to date with knowledge and information that supports effectiveness as a Therapeutic Strategy Lead e.g. understanding IQVIA’ services, tools and product offerings, status and trends in cardiology, innovations and advances in clinical trial methodology, and business intelligence.
  • Broad protocol and therapeutic knowledge.
  • Comprehensive global knowledge, awareness, and practical understanding of the biopharma industry, drug development lifecycle and operational clinical trial delivery.
  • Robust and current knowledge of scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial and competitive landscape in applicable therapeutic areas.
  • Strong leadership skills, ability to work with minimal supervision, and lead a virtual team in a matrix organization.
  • Flexible and able to work in situations where specifications may or may not be well defined and willing to support work in other therapeutic areas when required.
  • Confident and capable in the use of technology, applications, and other media e.g. databases and internet to research new opportunities, maintain currency of therapeutic and operational knowledge, and competitive landscape.

MINIMUM REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's Degree in life sciences, advanced degree preferred, with extensive knowledge of Internal Medicine diseases.
  • 10 years and above global clinical research experience, including hands on Phase I operational delivery and/or drug development experience.
  • Proven track record in operational delivery and/or drug development; or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  • Must have extensive experience with Clinical Operations and Clinical Project Management.
  • Experience in internal medicine is required, including—but not limited to—areas such as rheumatology, dermatology, gastroenterology, and immunology.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

In this role, you'll apply your frontend development expertise and design sensibility to build pixel-perfect, responsive, and conversion-focused websites that meet real client requirements. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in landing page production, multi-page website development, and modern frontend frameworks.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Frontend Developer, you'll design, build, and refine landing pages, waitlist pages, promo pages, and small multi-page sites (portfolios, restaurant sites, small business sites, simple online stores), turning client briefs into responsive, performant, polished web experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build landing pages, waitlist pages, and promo pages with clear hero sections, CTAs, and conversion-focused layouts.
  • Build small multi-page websites (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.) that follow client requirements and basic information architecture.
  • Implement responsive, mobile-first layouts that work cleanly across devices and browsers.
  • Integrate forms, email capture, basic analytics, and simple CMS or headless content sources.
  • Apply on-page SEO basics (semantic HTML, meta tags, performance, accessibility) so pages are ready to rank and run ads against.
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refine frontend markup, styling, structure, and content placement to deliver production-quality websites.
  • Troubleshoot layout, performance, and cross-browser issues independently.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in frontend development, landing page production, or website development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Design, or related fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in modern frontend development, responsive web design, and building high-quality landing pages and small websites. We are looking for specialists who can create polished, conversion-focused user experiences, work confidently with modern frontend frameworks, and build production-ready user interfaces. A strong visual eye, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including responsive design, Flexbox, and Grid.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro, or similar).
  • Experience with utility-first CSS (Tailwind) or modern component libraries.
  • Ability to translate Figma designs or written briefs into clean, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with form handling, email capture services, and basic analytics setup (GA4, Plausible, or similar).
  • Working knowledge of on-page SEO, accessibility (WCAG basics), and Core Web Vitals.
  • Comfortable working with simple CMSs or headless content (Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Contentful, or similar) is a plus.

Additional requirements

jobs.excerpt: About TeamsharesTeamshares is a technology-enabled acquirer of small and midsize businesses.
jobs.description:
About Teamshares

Teamshares is a technology-enabled acquirer of small and midsize businesses. We buy companies with $0.5 million to $5 million in EBITDA, integrate them with our platform, and help employees become owners. Founded in 2019, we operate 90+ subsidiaries with approximately $490 million in consolidated revenue across 40+ industries and 30 states.

The Role

We're looking for a NetSuite Solution Architect to design and lead ERP implementations across our network of 90+ companies. You'll own the technical architecture for how we deploy NetSuite, make design decisions that affect multiple companies, unblock complex technical problems, and establish standards so implementations scale consistently.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll work directly with implementation partners and company finance teams, do solution design presentations, troubleshoot technical issues, and influence how we approach NetSuite across the network. You're hands-on, not managing others.

You'll have significant technical influence and decision authority. As we grow, you'll build and lead a small team. We're looking for someone who can handle the immediate hands-on architecture work while growing into leadership of this function.

Context: We're running multiple NetSuite implementations and considering our long-term platform strategy. About two-thirds of our network is still on QuickBooks Online, and we evaluate financial-systems decisions strategically. You'll help define how NetSuite fits into our broader technology roadmap.

Responsibilities

NetSuite Architecture & Technical Strategy: Define the technical architecture for NetSuite deployments. Make strategic decisions about single-instance vs. multi-instance, data integration, reporting, and customization boundaries. Document architecture decisions and evolve them as you learn.

Solution Design & Customer Engagement: Work with implementation partners and company finance teams to design solutions. Present options, explain trade-offs, and make recommendations on configuration vs. customization vs. integration. Ensure solutions fit business needs without over-engineering.

Technical Standards & Best Practices: Establish NetSuite standards and best practices across all implementations. Define how we handle common scenarios: multi-subsidiary accounting, intercompany transactions, reporting structures, integrations. Share these standards with implementation partners.

Vendor & Partner Assessment: Evaluate implementation consultants and integration partners from a technical perspective. Assess proposals, challenge over-engineered solutions, and recommend the right vendor approach. Work as a peer with partners, not a gatekeeper.

Technical Problem-Solving & Troubleshooting: When implementation teams encounter complex technical issues, you're the escalation point. Diagnose problems, work with partners to find solutions, and make recommendations. Roll up your sleeves on troubleshooting as needed.

What We're Looking For

7-12 years of ERP implementation, solution architecture, or enterprise systems consulting experience.

Deep hands-on knowledge of NetSuite or similar enterprise systems. You understand data models, module design, reporting, integrations, and customization options.

Experience working in presales, customer-facing architecture, or consulting roles. You're comfortable with ambiguity, can present design options, and work through technical trade-offs with customers.

Strong technical design judgment. You can evaluate trade-offs between configuration, customization, integration, and process change. You make decisions based on business value, not technical elegance.

At Varsity Spirit, the safety and wellbeing of the young people we serve is of the utmost importance. Since our inception 50 years ago, we have been – and remain – steadfastly committed to doing our part to create a safe and positive environment for our participants’ physical, emotional, and social development, and promoting an environment free from abuse and misconduct. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

The Director of Software Product Marketing leads the strategy, development, and promotion of Varsity Yearbook’s proprietary software tools used by schools nationwide. As a key member of the marketing leadership team, this role owns both the product roadmap (in partnership with IT) and the go-to-market strategy for these digital solutions—ensuring they meet the evolving needs of advisers, students, and field sales partners.

This leader plays a central role in how software products are shaped, messaged, launched, and supported in the field. They oversee customer-facing help resources and content, partner closely with internal product and development teams, and ensure software tools are clearly positioned and effectively adopted by B2B customers. The ideal candidate is equal parts strategist, communicator, and customer advocate—capable of bridging the gap between product development, marketing, and user experience.

Product Strategy & Development

  • Lead the marketing organization’s involvement in software product strategy, feature prioritization, and user experience decisions

  • Serve as the primary liaison to the IT/software development team, advocating for user needs and business priorities

  • Define and evolve the product roadmap in alignment with customer feedback, competitive trends, and strategic goals

  • Ensure all product development aligns with brand standards, user expectations, and market differentiation

Go-to-Market & Product Marketing

  • Own messaging, positioning, and promotion of Varsity Yearbook’s proprietary software tools

  • Develop go-to-market strategies for new software features and platform updates

  • Collaborate with sales, customer experience, and creative teams to develop launch materials, videos, training guides, and email campaigns

  • Ensure internal teams and customers clearly understand product benefits, usage, and competitive advantage

Customer Enablement & Help Resources

  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of digital and printed customer-facing help content (guides, videos, tutorials, knowledge base)

  • Develop systems and processes for software onboarding, adoption, and in-app guidance

  • Partner with the Field Marketing and Customer Experience teams to deliver scalable training resources and toolkits

  • Measure the effectiveness of customer resources and identify opportunities for content improvements

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Act as the strategic connector between marketing, IT, product, and customer-facing teams

  • Translate technical capabilities into clear, benefit-driven messaging for non-technical audiences

  • Lead internal communication plans and field readiness efforts for major software releases

Team & Budget Management

  • Manage software product marketing budgets, timelines, and vendor relationships

  • Lead and develop any direct reports or contractors supporting product marketing and enablement

  • Contribute as a member of the marketing leadership team, helping shape broader departmental priorities and cross-functional workflows

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong yearbook industry experience and understanding of user needs

  • 7+ years of experience in product marketing or product management, with a focus on software or technology tools

  • Strong understanding of B2B marketing, digital tools, and SaaS-style product development cycles

  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects and translate technical ideas into compelling customer-facing experiences

  • Exceptional written, visual, and verbal communication skills

  • Experience in education, publishing, or ed-tech markets preferred

jobs.excerpt: At Allucent™, we are dedicated to helping small-medium biopharmaceutical companies efficiently navigate the complex world of clinical trials to bring life-changing therapies to patients in need across the globe.
jobs.description:
At Allucent™, we are dedicated to helping small-medium biopharmaceutical companies efficiently navigate the complex world of clinical trials to bring life-changing therapies to patients in need across the globe.

We are looking for a Clinical Trial Leader (CTL) to join our A-team (office-based*/remote). As a CTL at Allucent, you are providing leadership, management and oversight to the Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and other clinical functional groups, in their day-to-day clinical trial activities on a global, multi-country, or regional basis. The CTL is responsible for coordinating and managing the planning, implementation, tracking, and ensuring the clinical deliverables as per the trial contract, budget, timelines and with quality.

Responsibilities

As an expert in Clinical Trial Leadership, you are:

  • Coordinating and managing CRA activities across all geographies, liaising with sponsor and Project Manager and other functional leads to ensure clinical monitoring deliverables (timeline, budget, quality, productivity) are met.
  • Liaising closely with the Project Manager (PM) and other department leaders if /when necessary, on all trial-related issues and service delivery.
  • Supporting the management team with training, process improvements, co-monitoring visits, mentoring of staff and / or any other special assignments within Global Clinical Operations.

Requirements

To be successful you will possess:

  • A degree in life sciences or nursing qualification preferred, but not required.
  • A minimum of 5 years clinical research experience with at least 1 year as a Senior CRA or other relevant experience. 
  • In-depth knowledge of ICH GCP, clinical trials and the critical elements for success in clinical trials 
  • Strong therapeutic background in oncology
  • Possesses experience and knowledge in the CRO industry that will support Allucent’s management of clinical trials 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills including professional command of English language to communicate with internal and external stakeholders on a daily basis.

Benefits

Benefits of working at Allucent include:

  • Comprehensive benefits package per location
  • Competitive salaries per location
  • Departmental Study/Training Budget for furthering professional development
  • Flexible Working hours (within reason)
  • Opportunity for remote/hybrid* working depending on location
  • Leadership and mentoring opportunities
  • Participation in our Buddy Program as a new or existing employee
  • Internal growth opportunities and career progression
  • Financially rewarding internal employee referral program

Disclaimers:

*Our office-based work policy encourages a dynamic work environment, prescribing a minimum of 2 days in office per week for employees within reasonable distance from one of our global offices.

Unsolicited resumes sent to Allucent employees will not obligate Allucent to the future employment of those individuals or potential remuneration to any third-party recruitment agency. Candidates should never be submitted directly to our hiring managers, employees, or human resources.”

jobs.title: Record Your Daily Routine & Get Paid - AI Training
jobs.excerpt: This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job.
jobs.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $10 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

jobs.excerpt: We exist to create positive change for people and the planet.
jobs.description:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!

Job Title: Product Certification Auditor (Client Manager)
Reports to: Operations Manager in UK

Location: Home based

Purpose of the position:
As the face of BSI, the role of the Auditor (Client Manager) is to work closely with BSI clients to help them improve their performance by assessing their systems and processes against BSI standards. At the end of each assessment the Client Manager compiles a business report and presents this to the client.
Context / Dimensions:
The scope of the position will typically cover clients within the region of the role holder however some wider UK delivery may be required. The role is home-based.

Are you ready to be part of a world-renowned organization with nearly 120 years of innovation, growth, and industry leadership? Do you have a passion enabling organisations to continue maintaining high standards of compliance?

At BSI, we are looking for a Built Environment Auditor to play a key role in maintaining product excellence. In this role, you’ll conduct product certification assessments across varied environments, ensuring compliance with BSI’s rigorous certification schemes and Kitemark standards.

We are seeking professionals to deliver Building Information Modelling (BIM) related product assessment in accordance with ISO 19650 framework. Previous auditing experience is a plus, as well as expertise in quality management systems (ISO 9001). Experience with PAS 2080 (Carbon Management in Infrastructure) would also be a distinct benefit.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Prepare assessment reports and deliver findings to clients to ensure client understanding of the assessment decision and clear direction to particular items of corrective action where appropriate
  • Recommend the issue, re-issue or withdrawal of certificates, and report recommendations in accordance with BSI policy, procedures and prescribed time frame.
  • Maintain overall account responsibility and accountability for nominated accounts to ensure an effective partnership, whilst ensuring excellent service delivery and account growth.
  • Lead assessment teams as required ensuring that team members are adequately briefed so that quality of service is maintained and that effective working relationships are sustained both with Clients and within the team.
  • Provide accurate and prompt information to support services, working closely with them to ensure that client records are up to date and complete and that all other internal information requirements are met.
  • Coach colleagues as appropriate especially where those members are inexperienced assessors or unfamiliar with clients' business/technology and assist in the induction and coaching of new colleagues as requested
  • Plan/schedule workloads to make best use of own time and maximise revenue-earning activity.
  • Responsible for attending any required training and following all procedures/processes/policies within BSI for management of clients, management of a home based office, use of BSI equipment and communication both internal and external to the organization
  • Must be willing to go through extensive onboarding plan in order to reach Lead Assessor status through the prescribed program (based on the knowledge, skills and experience they have as well as the requirements of the appropriate schemes)
  • Must be able to demonstrate knowledge and skills, to include preparation for and taking standardized assessments related to knowledge and application of audit practices
  • Responsible for managing a portfolio of assigned clients based on location and a match of qualifications and client contract requirements
  • Responsible for contacting clients and scheduling the visits, planning the assessments, making travel plans, conducting the assessments and reporting and managing the results in an efficient manner.
  • Responsible for monitoring the client accounts to ensure that records, visit cycle, invoicing and other related matters are properly dealt with to assure client satisfaction is maintained
  • Responsible for leading teams, when necessary, and mentoring and coaching new or inexperienced colleagues as needed to meet the business needs
  • Any other assignments as needed to meet assessment delivery business objectives.

Education/Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 4 years’ industry experience gained within BIM, Built Environment, Construction or similar industry sector
  • Expertise across ISO 19650, Building Information Modelling (BIM) Framework
  • Experience with PAS 2080 Carbon Management in Infrastructure would be desirable
  • Previous experience in 3rd party external auditing, against standards
  • Can travel frequently
  • Knowledge of quality management system (ISO 9001) auditing practices.

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Gestão de Time

  • Mapear canais, veículos e formatos mais relevantes para o público B2B de saúde
  • Acompanhar indicadores de share of voice e percepção de marca


Eventos

Job Title: Korean Bilingual Expert

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Key Responsibilities

  1. Transcribe and translate video content accurately between Korean and English, with attention to detail and thorough time-stamping.

  3. Evaluate and ensure grammatical, syntactic, and structural fidelity in both Korean and English communications.
  4. Clarify and interpret complex or nuanced terminology, conveying conceptual depth with precision.
  5. Conduct advanced linguistic tasks, such as tone analysis and contextual interpretation, supporting multimedia projects.
  6. Collaborate on diverse language and communication tasks based on evolving project requirements.
  7. Consistently deliver high-quality, reliable results within agreed-upon timelines, maintaining at least 15 hours of weekly commitment.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  1. Fluency in both written and spoken Korean and English, with a strong focus on articulate, effective communication.

  4. Keen attention to grammatical detail, linguistic structure, and contextual accuracy.
  5. Excellent time management and organizational abilities, with a proven track record of meeting deadlines.
  6. Self-motivated and resourceful in a remote, independent work environment while maintaining open and clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Academic background or degree in linguistics, translation, communications, or a closely related field.
  2. Experience working with complex language, transcription projects, or multimedia content analysis.
  3. Familiarity with digital transcription software and relevant language tools.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Support Representative
jobs.excerpt: ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents.
jobs.description:
ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. ECP is used in over 8,000 communities around the world. We're looking to further expand by increasing the number of customers that use our software and increasing the scope of how we serve our customers by developing and releasing new products.

Role Overview

As a Customer Support Specialist III (Level 3 Triage) at ECP, you serve as the final Support escalation point and primary technical triage resource before issues are escalated to Dev, Pharmacy, Billing, Compliance, or Product. You are responsible for reproducing complex customer issues, validating bugs, and ensuring that only well-documented, actionable cases reach downstream teams.

This role focuses on deep technical investigation, quality control, and proactive product support. You act as the bridge between Support & other teams—reducing noise, improving issue quality, and helping ensure smoother releases through active participation in testing prior to product launches.

In addition to triage responsibilities, this role supports continuous improvement by identifying systemic issues, strengthening documentation, and enabling Levels 1 and 2 through knowledge sharing.

Core Responsibilities

Technical Triage & Issue Replication

  • Serve as the final Support escalation point for complex or ambiguous issues prior to Engineering or Product involvement
  • Reproduce reported issues in staging or test environments to confirm behavior and isolate root causes
  • Perform detailed technical investigation across product workflows, integrations, and configurations
  • Determine whether issues represent product defects, configuration problems, or expected behavior
  • Gather logs, screenshots, steps to reproduce, and environmental context to create complete, actionable tickets
  • Act as a gatekeeper for escalations, ensuring only validated (to the best of ability) and properly documented issues are passed to Engineering
  • Assisting with categorization of severity and prioritization of tickets and issues
  • Monitor ticket data for trends and work proactively with leadership to address
  • Act as a triage between support & Dev, “translating” ticket information to be digestible in both directions
  • Act as backup for management needs when manager out of office or requires assistance

Bug Validation & Release Support

  • Validate suspected bugs by confirming reproducibility and impact
  • Assist Engineering by providing clear reproduction steps, test scenarios, and customer context
  • Participate in regression testing and validation of fixes prior to deployment
  • Support Product and Engineering during release cycles by assisting with QA and pre-launch testing
  • Help identify potential customer-impacting issues before product launches

Documentation & Systems Management

  • Maintain highly detailed ticket documentation following ECP best practices
  • Ensure accurate categorization and tracking of bugs and escalations in HubSpot and ECP’s ticketing system
  • Contribute to internal technical documentation, troubleshooting workflows, and release notes

Knowledge Sharing & Team Enablement

  • Provide feedback loops Support regarding root causes and resolutions
  • Deliver teach-backs after triaged issues to improve frontline troubleshooting and reduce escalation volume
  • Serve as a technical product expert and trusted resource across Support
  • Identify recurring patterns and recommend training, documentation, or product improvements

Performance & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain ownership of triaged issues through resolution, ensuring timely follow-up and cross-team communication
  • Consistently meet or exceed established KPIs, SLAs, and quality standards
  • Balance triage workload with testing, documentation, and team enablement responsibilities

Expectations for Success in This Role

  • Demonstrate strong ownership of technical investigations and escalation quality
  • Exhibit advanced analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Deep understanding of all of our product offerings
  • Ensure Engineering receives complete, reproducible, and well-scoped tickets
  • Proactively improve Support effectiveness through documentation and coaching
  • Maintain a customer-first mindset while operating in a highly technical capacity
  • Uphold ECP values and represent Support professionally across all teams

Requirements

Requirements

    • 3+ years Customer Service Experience
    • 1+ years escalated Technical Support Experience
    • Strong understanding of Billing/Financial terminology & process is preferred
    • Software experience, experience with JIRA, ServiceDesk, & UAT is preferred
    • Strong problem-solving capabilities, ability to replicate and test suspected bugs
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills & ability to clearly communicate steps taken for replication, and suspected issues.
    • Comfort learning new systems and technologies quickly
    • Bachelor or Associate's degree preferred
    • A remote work environment that is compliant with cybersecurity and other company workplace policies
    • Work Hours / Schedule:
      • The regular work hours will be 8:00 am CT ( 6:00 am PT, 7:00 am MT, 9:00 am ET) to 5:30 pm CT (3:30 pm PT, 4:30 pm MT, 6:30 pm ET), Monday through Friday.
      • Support team members are required to participate in the on-call/after-hours rotational schedule

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Finance Technology
jobs.excerpt: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Role

Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.

You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.

You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
  • As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
  • Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
  • Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
  • Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
  • Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
  • Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
  • Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
  • Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
  • Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
  • Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
  • Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.

Strategic Orchestration & Influence

  • Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
  • Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
  • Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.

Team Leadership

  • Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
  • Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
  • Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
  • Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
  • Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.

Hands-On Product Ownership:

  • Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
  • This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
  • Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.

Vendor and Demand Management

  • Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
  • Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
  • Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
  • Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
  • Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
  • Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
  • Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people.
  • Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll).
  • Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management.
  • Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps
  • Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent.
  • Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform.
  • Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon.
  • Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts.
  • Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies.
  • Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a high-growth public technology company
  • Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments
  • Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows
  • Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover)
  • Exposure to SOX compliance considerations in finance systems
  • Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models

Why This Role, Why Reddit

Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work.

You'll have the autonomy to set direction, the team support to execute, and the organizational access to make product decisions that stick.

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. jobs.title: Senior Director, Brand & Communications
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Director of Brand & Communications is a strategic and creative leader responsible for shaping and stewarding the voice, brand, and narrative of the organization across all internal and external channels, ensuring that every communication advances the organization’s mission, reflects its values, and tells the story of its impact and commitment to justice-centered philanthropy around the globe.
jobs.description:
The Senior Director of Brand & Communications is a strategic and creative leader responsible for shaping and stewarding the voice, brand, and narrative of the organization across all internal and external channels, ensuring that every communication advances the organization’s mission, reflects its values, and tells the story of its impact and commitment to justice-centered philanthropy around the globe. This role leads the development and execution of a comprehensive communications strategy that advances the organization’s mission and business development, strengthens its visibility and credibility, and fosters alignment and engagement among staff, partners, and the broader philanthropic and social impact ecosystem.

Reporting to the Co-Chief Executive Officer, the Director oversees all aspects of brand management, digital and media strategy, Office of the CEO and executive leadership communications, storytelling, and internal communications. This role ensures the organization’s communications reflect its values, highlight its work and impact, elevate its voice and visibility, and connect authentically with diverse philanthropy audiences—including grantees, funders, staff, global collaborators, and the public. The Senior Director understands the power of narrative to; drive systems change, promote RPA’s mission, commitment to equity, community-centered messaging. the proven ability to translate complex work into compelling, accessible content.

Accountabilities

Strategic Communications Strategy and Execution

  • Develop a communications and branding strategy aligned with the organization’s mission and strategic plan.

  • Partner with leadership as relevant to ensure clear, cohesive messaging in RPA’s voice across all internal and external platforms including newsletters, website, social media, and publications.

  • Refine the organization’s voice, brand, and narrative in a way that centers justice and equity and is grounded in cultural competence.

  • Determine approaches and messages that align with mission and brand that support RPA’s continued viability and sustainability, including key audience channels and aligned messages that support donor development and partnerships.

  • Elevate the visibility of RPA’s thought leadership in partnership with Inquiry and Insights.

  • Serve as strategic advisor to the Co-CEOs on messaging and public speaking.

External Communications and Public Engagement

  • Lead media relations, including proactive press outreach, rapid response, and relationship management with journalists and sector influencers.

  • Oversee the digital strategy and content, including website, social media, newsletters, and multimedia storytelling and provide direction to the team on implementation.

  • Partner with executive leadership and teams across the organization, including core teams, Advisory, and Sponsored Project leadership to support communication efforts around key initiatives, events, and campaigns and amplify programmatic, core operations, and thought leadership work.

  • Maintains enterprise-wide awareness, including major sponsored project communications and provides executive counsel and risk-based communications guidance for complex, high-visibility, or sensitive matters that may impact the organization's reputation, stakeholders, or strategic objectives.

  • Develop and oversee processes for tracking initiatives, campaigns, and outreach.

Internal Communications

  • Design and implement internal communications systems that strengthen employee connection, clarity, and alignment.

  • Collaborate with core teams to ensure transparent and timely communication during change, growth, or strategic planning efforts.

  • Build resources to support staff in communications opportunities and engagements (e.g., media training, message alignment, sharing on social media, etc.).

Media, Brand Stewardship, & Visibility

  • Refine and protect the organization’s brand identity and voice across all touchpoints, ensuring alignment with values of justice, equity, trust, and community.

  • Oversee brand assets and ensure consistency across visual design, tone, and messaging.

  • Manage organizational media presence, including pitching, placements, and media relationships.

  • Partner with functional leaders to develop, manage, and curate strategic visibility opportunities for Co-CEOs, executive leadership, and colleagues, thoughtfully positioning them to represent RPA externally.

  • Maintain and strengthen a coherent, values-aligned brand identity and experience.

Complexity and Problem-solving

  • Uses expertise to act as an organizational authority on planning, organizing, prioritizing, and overseeing communications activities to efficiently meet RPA’s objectives.

  • Exercises independent judgment in developing solutions to apply a comprehensive understanding of the sector environment and the organization’s objectives, developing solutions while providing guidance to others.

  • Applies expertise to act as the organizational authority on maximizing RPA’s brand impact and market value by managing and developing all aspects of the brand.

  • Works at an advanced level and exercises broad decision-making authority in developing communications and brand strategies, navigating ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, and aligning leaders to achieve organizational objectives.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Direct supervision of communications staff

  • Management of external vendors, agencies, and consultants

  • Collaboration with cross-functional leaders on integrated campaigns and messaging.

Travel Requirements

Some travel may be required.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, marketing, public relations, or related field or equivalent experience required (12+ years).

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and verbal communications skills

  • Proven senior level experience developing and executing communications strategies, including digital strategy, in a nonprofit, philanthropic, or mission-driven organization.

  • Strong understanding of social justice, equity-focused language, and narrative change principles.

  • Track record of managing media relationships, digital platforms, and brand identity systems.

  • Familiarity with philanthropy sector audiences and the communications nuances of donor/grantee/stakeholder engagement.

At Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors, our mission is to accelerate philanthropy in pursuit of a just world, by providing deep global expertise to make philanthropy more thoughtful, equitable and effective.

  • We believe that philanthropy can help create a better world

  • We make decisions that center people and communities.

  • We believe philanthropy has a responsibility to pursue equity.

  • We uphold the highest standards of integrity and trust.

  • We are committed to learning and sharing knowledge.

If our mission resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. You may bring valuable perspectives and experiences that aren’t captured here but could contribute meaningfully to our work. We’re excited to learn what you can offer.

Compensation & Benefits

Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including health coverage, retirement benefits, paid sick leave, vacationand holidays, tuitionreimbursement and access to professional development resources.

The salary range is one component of the total compensation package for employees.

Pay Range: $195,000 - $205,000 salary per year

Application Process

Applications will be reviewed as received. In order to be considered, all applications must include a cover letter describing your interest and qualifications and your resume. The position will remain open until filled.

Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors celebrates the uniqueness of our staff, our partners, and the communities we serve. We are committed to inclusion with the goal of cultivating a culture of belonging and acceptance. We strive to embed this value in our philanthropic work to advance a more just, equitable and sustainable world.

RPA is an equal opportunity employer.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will help Amgen turn approved AI capabilities into practical, responsible and repeatable solutions. Soft Skills:

  • Organized approach to managing priorities and following through on commitments.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach with global and virtual partners.

Ми, Honeytech – динамічний, швидкозростаючий проект, що створив платформу з коміксами в азійській стилістиці та вже став № 1 у своїй ніші! Уяви Netflix, але для коміксів – лише за кілька років ми зібрали 10+ мільйонів користувачів, кинули виклик гігантам з Південної Кореї й довели, що можемо будувати продукт світового рівня з України!

Що чекає на тебе з нами?

  • 🚀 Динамічний розвиток: минулого року наш проект виріс у 10 разів і ми продовжуємо набирати оберти – запускаємо нові продукти та плануємо зрости ще втричі!

  • 📈 Можливості твого швидкого карʼєрного зростання: це позиція з горизонтом зростання, ширшою зоною впливу, стратегічними рішеннями та побудовою напрямку під себе.

  • 🎯 Глибоке розуміння перформансу: наші креативні маркетологи напряму працюють з UAM-командою: знають, як і де запускаються їхні креативи, бачать результати в реальному часі та можуть самостійно лити трафік за бажанням і для прокачки експертизи.

  • 🤩Пряма комунікація та прозорі процеси: ми любимо здоровий глузд більше, ніж заплутані процедури та уникаємо зайву бюрократію.

  • 📊Сильна аналітика та підтримка data-команди: доступ до ключових метрик, продумана аналітична інфраструктура та окрема аналітична команда. Працюємо з Tableau, тому всі рішення – на основі цифр, а не інтуїції.

Твоя майбутня зона відповідальності:

  • Менеджмент Creative Marketing team та участь у всіх процесах повʼязаних з управлінням, мотивацією та розвитком команди.

  • Впровадження та створення інноваційних і успішних креативних методів.

  • Проведення якісного аналізу ринкових трендів і конкурентів, визначення основних тенденцій для створення рекламних креативів, можливостей для зростання та перспектив масштабування.

  • Співпраця з product та user acquisition командами для забезпечення ефективного планування та виконання цілей.

  • Оцінка ефективності поточних креативів і розробка стратегій для покращення результатів.

Ти наш ідеальний кандидат, якщо маєш:

  • Від 2 років досвіду в креативному маркетингу з розумінням, як креатив впливає на перформанс.

  • Досвід менторства або менеджменту команди/молодших колег.

  • Орієнтація на метрики та Data-driven підхід в роботі.

  • Лідерські якості та вміння вести команду за собою – мотивувати, задавати напрямок і рухатись до спільного результату.

  • Володіння англійською мовою на рівні Upper-Intermediate та вище.

Цікаво, що ще пропонуємо?

  • Робота на найбільш конкурентних ринках Tier1 (США, Канада, Британія, Австралія і т.д), що дозволяє стати експертом у своїй справі.

  • Віддалена робота або можливість працювати з нашого офісу в Києві, що повністю обладнаний для роботи під час відключень світла + можливість користуватись коворкінгом у Варшаві та Львові.

  • 20 робочих днів відпустки на рік (після 3 місяців співпраці) та до 30 днів sick leave з медичним підтвердженням. А також можливість трансферу робочих днів та days off по державних святах України.

  • Веселі тімбілдінги та корпоративні подорожі.

  • Програма HoneyFit — компенсація спортивних активностей та івентів, оффлайн/онлайн тренувань тощо (по завершенню випробувального терміну).

  • Допомога в релокації, оплата коворкінгів або допомога у придбанні зарядних станцій для комфортної роботи під час відключення електропостачання (після 3х місяців співпраці).

  • Різноманітні можливості для навчання: доповіді спікерів у різноманітних напрямах, велика корпоративна бібліотека, компенсація зовнішніх курсів і, звичайно, уроки англійської мови + speaking clubs.

  • Внутрішня корпоративна валюта Boosta coins.

  • Але найголовніше: Honeytech — це команда професіоналів, де кожний відчуває підтримку та досягає своїх цілей!

jobs.title: HR Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is to help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities across our offices and remote locations. We are looking for people who enjoy building, improving, and solving problems.

About the Role

You will lead HR Operations for BJAK's global team.

You will own the operational foundation that supports employees across multiple countries, ensuring HR processes are accurate, compliant, and scalable as the company grows.

This is a hands-on role. You will build and improve HR processes, manage global HR operations, and work with local partners and vendors to ensure a consistent employee experience across different markets.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own HR operations across the global employee lifecycle, including onboarding, transfers, promotions, and offboarding

  • Build and improve HR processes, policies, and SOPs that can scale across multiple countries

  • Oversee global HR systems, employee records, reporting, and data governance

  • Manage payroll coordination, benefits administration, employment documentation, and statutory compliance with local partners and EOR providers where applicable

  • Ensure HR operations remain accurate, compliant, and audit-ready across all locations

  • Improve operational efficiency through process redesign, automation, and system improvements

  • Lead and develop the HR Operations function while partnering with leadership to support global expansion

What You Will Need

  • 7+ years of experience in HR Operations, People Operations, or HR Administration

  • Experience supporting employees across multiple countries or regions

  • Strong understanding of global HR operations, employment documentation, payroll coordination, HR systems, and compliance

  • Experience building and improving HR processes in a fast-growing company

  • Strong operational mindset with high attention to detail

  • Comfortable balancing hands-on execution with process improvement

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Ability to work across different countries, cultures, and time zones

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in China. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in China.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Pay Range:

$24.10 - $36.15

Provides initial technical support to customers while delivering excellent customer experience during interactions regarding computers, servers, applications and hardware issues. Assesses the nature of the issue, responds to Incidents and requests for service, and resolves or escalates using documented procedures and checklists and by simulating or recreating the incident. Documents all calls in the tracking system; escalating complex problems to more experienced support, when necessary.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Provides initial support troubleshooting, answering questions and resolving basic problems and issues related to LAN/WAN-based software, desktop computing equipment, printers, network status and applications.

  • Understanding of the technical components of an Information System, including basic hardware, platform, database concepts, and terminology.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.  Strong written and verbal communication skills including the ability to interact with a diverse customer population and communicate at their level.  

  • to use/manage a standard multiple-line telephone system.

  • Must be able to perform fine hand manipulation when using a keyboard.  

  • Position may require occasional travel which may result in exposure to road and weather hazards.
